notice.en: A row says WHERE an intervention could be tried for a cell. It is a hypothesis of where to intervene, never a cause: the cells are associations and a contact is not linkable to a complaint.
notice.es: Una fila dice DONDE se podria probar una intervencion para una celda. Es una hipotesis de donde intervenir, nunca una causa: las celdas son asociaciones y un contacto no se enlaza con una queja.
notice.pt: Uma linha diz ONDE uma intervencao poderia ser testada para uma celula. E uma hipotese de onde intervir, nunca uma causa: as celulas sao associacoes e um contato nao se liga a uma reclamacao.

provenance.ordering_rule: 1 prefer a patch of an EXISTING artifact when an existing agent covers the topic (user priority: new agents, prompt changes, links to existing tools, policies, flows; a new agent only for an UNCOVERED topic); 2 at equal footing, candidates whose proof can run and be announced now come first (announceable_now); 3 a candidate never leaves the closed kinds patch and new_agent (policy values, interrupts, injection rulesets, language detection, tools, release_settings, constructor-chat, pulso-* agents and model profiles are not representable)

sources.live_passes: docs/reports/b3-live-pass.md and docs/dev/DEMO_LOOP.md (DEMO1/INTEG5: new-agent proposals end not_announced:infra_failed, put_draft forbidden_role 403)

complaint_followup.why: Complaint (PQR) follow-up is served today: consultas answers status inquiries, disputas files card-charge disputes (about a third of the complaints), copiloto-asesor is the advisor-side copilot for phone contacts. The finding says WHERE contacts stay unresolved, not why.

uncovered_reason.why: Tecnico, Comercial and Retencion contacts have no specialist in the directory (recepcion routes only to disputas and consultas); 46 percent of the unresolved contacts sit in reasons without a specialist.
uncovered_reason.evidence: BANK_DATA_AUDIT F02 and section 5; ANATOMY 1.2 and R3

pqr_status.why: A PQR backlog finding (open or SLA-breached by category) lands on the status message of consultas.

tool_peers.why: Peers (the advisor copilot) read the customer's cases with leer_pqr_cliente while the customer-facing consultas agent only reads one PQR by radicado; a read tool that exists and that peers use is the candidate link (ART2).
tool_peers.evidence: ARTIFACT_KINDS_FEASIBILITY 4.3; TEL1 A5 tool_share vs peers (agent_signal_mapping.json, not merged)

advisor_repeated_lookup.why: The same recent-charges lookup repeated inside a dispute case is the advisor copilot's tool-choice step.

copilot_draft_quality.why: The advisor copilot already drafts replies for analysts; whether the drafts are used, edited, discarded or ignored is the analysts own verdict on its prompt, by case type and by release.

copilot_coverage.why: The copilot returned nothing for these cases (copilot.suggestion_none): a topic it was not given material for, or a tool it does not have. Which of the two is a human decision.

assistant_handoff_charge.why: Card-charge cases are served by the disputas assistant; a high escalation rate on those case types means customers leave that flow for an analyst.
assistant_handoff_charge.evidence: ANATOMY D1 and section 1.1; PLATFORM_SIGNALS 2026-10-05 section 4(e) (escalation rate by cell)

candidates.justification: Unresolved complaint contacts are largely 'where is my claim'; consultas covers that topic and its t/estado_pqr answers every status request with one static sentence that never reads the PQR state.
candidates.evidence: ANATOMY F2 / C1; STAR_STORY 1a (open PQR backlog)

candidates.justification: A share of complaints are card-charge disputes covered by disputas; its generated closing message confirms the filing but does not say who follows the case up.
candidates.evidence: ANATOMY D2 and section 1.1 (36.5 percent of complaints are Cargo no reconocido / Cobro indebido)

candidates.justification: The dispute clarify loop answers one short static sentence when no charge matches; a customer who cannot find the charge may call again.
Phone contacts are handled by advisors, whose copilot prompt (es and pt differ in length and rules) is the only existing artifact on that path.
Last resort: only the part of the complaints that no existing agent covers would go to a new intake specialist, which needs an admin for its release settings before it can be announced.
No existing agent covers technical contacts, so the topic is uncovered: a narrow intake specialist cloned from consultas, not a claim of resolution.
These contacts are mostly phone calls answered by advisors; the copilot prompt is the existing artifact on the advisor path (hypothesis, there is no regression suite generator for it yet).
No existing agent covers commercial contacts, so the topic is uncovered: a narrow intake specialist cloned from consultas.
Mostly phone contacts answered by advisors; the copilot prompt is the existing artifact on that path (no suite generator yet).
No existing agent covers retention contacts, so the topic is uncovered: a narrow intake specialist cloned from consultas.
Mostly phone contacts answered by advisors; the copilot prompt is the existing artifact on that path (no suite generator yet).
consultas covers PQR status inquiries and its status template never reads the status.
Peers use the read tool leer_pqr_cliente a lot and consultas does not have it: the link adds a pass-through read of the customer's cases to its flow, wired to the existing tool_failure exit.
candidates.evidence: ARTIFACT_KINDS_FEASIBILITY 4.3 (agent lacks a tool its peers use); TEL1 A5 (proposal rows, not merged)

candidates.justification: The repeated recent-charges lookup in dispute cases is the tool-choice step of the advisor copilot.
Analysts discard or ignore the copilot drafts far more often for this case type than for the others in the same channel; the copilot prompt is the existing artifact that shapes those drafts.
candidates.evidence: PLATFORM_SIGNALS section 4(e): draft acceptance by case type is the highest-value advisor signal

candidates.justification: Drafts of one release are rejected more often than those of the other releases of the same agent: a candidate regression of the prompt that release carries.
candidates.evidence: PLATFORM_SIGNALS section 4(b): release on copilot.suggestion_decided removes the staging/prod mixing of a timestamp cut

candidates.justification: When analysts do send the draft they rewrite most of it for this case type (aggregate edit-distance bucket, no text): the draft wording or structure misses what the analysts need.
candidates.evidence: PLATFORM_SIGNALS section 4(e): edit distance by case type; texts never leave the platform

candidates.justification: The copilot has nothing to say for this case type and channel: a knowledge gap in its prompt is the hypothesis the engine can test; a missing tool link is a human decision (tools are not an engine target).
Analysts reach for the same tool by hand in most of these cases: the copilot tool-choice step may not pick it for them.
candidates.evidence: ANATOMY P1 and Example 1; PLATFORM_SIGNALS section 2 (copilot.tool_used)

candidates.justification: More charge cases than elsewhere in the same channel leave the assistant for an analyst; the dispute clarify step answers one short static sentence when no charge matches, a place where a customer gives up.
candidates.evidence: ANATOMY D1; PLATFORM_SIGNALS section 4(e) (assistant escalation by case type)

human_owned.evidence: PLATFORM_SIGNALS 2026-10-05 section 2: case type is set by staff (case.type_changed); a type that is often corrected is a taxonomy or triage question

note.es: Para una persona (supervision): los casos de este tipo se reclasifican con frecuencia; si la taxonomia de tipos o el criterio de triaje es ambiguo lo decide quien opera la plataforma, no un parche propuesto por el motor.
note.pt: Para uma pessoa (supervisao): os casos deste tipo sao reclassificados com frequencia; se a taxonomia de tipos ou o criterio de triagem e ambiguo, quem opera a plataforma decide, nao um patch proposto pelo motor.

human_owned.evidence: PLATFORM_SIGNALS 2026-10-05 section 2: copilot.suggestion_failed carries a problem code, never a message; failures of the suggestion run are an operational question

note.es: Para una persona (plataforma): las sugerencias del copiloto fallan con frecuencia en esta celda; un fallo de la ejecucion no se corrige con un parche de texto del motor, lo revisa quien opera la plataforma y el gateway.
note.pt: Para uma pessoa (plataforma): as sugestoes do copiloto falham com frequencia nesta celula; uma falha de execucao nao se corrige com um patch de texto do motor, quem opera a plataforma e o gateway revisa.

human_owned.evidence: ANATOMY F6 and D5: the registry policy holds 500 USD, the team policy document says 250 USD (R4)

note.es: Para una persona (riesgo): la politica de escalamiento de disputas por monto no es un artefacto que el motor pueda proponer; el valor del registro y el del documento de politicas difieren y solo un responsable humano puede decidir cual rige.
note.pt: Para uma pessoa (risco): a politica de escalonamento de disputas por valor nao e um artefato que o motor possa propor; o valor do registro e o do documento de politicas diferem e so um responsavel humano pode decidir qual vale.

human_owned.evidence: ANATOMY F5 and F11: calibration thresholds are keyed by locale and exist only for es; the calibration is not a registry entity

note.es: Para una persona (plataforma): los umbrales de calibracion existen solo en espanol y no son parte del registro; una debilidad en portugues se corrige ahi, no con un parche de texto propuesto por el motor.
note.pt: Para uma pessoa (plataforma): os limiares de calibracao existem so em espanhol e nao fazem parte do registro; uma fraqueza em portugues se corrige ali, nao com um patch de texto proposto pelo motor.
